sources.title: Diff-MM: Exploring Pre-trained Text-to-Image Generation Model for ...
sources.snippet: Diff-MM leverages the UNet of pre-trained Stable Diffusion as a tracking feature extractor through the proposed parallel feature extraction pipeline, which enables pairwise image inputs for object tracking. We further introduce a multi-modal sub-module tuning method that learns to gain complementary information between different modalities.
